messages.text: Procurement leadership needs one defensible decision for vendor-caused equipment damage by 2026-01-16; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside incident evidence, asset, vendor responsibility, and repair scope.
I found 39 HR on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Approval AP-0050 permits one control-compliant action on NS-000050 up to 11 HR, provided incident evidence, asset, vendor responsibility, and repair scope. It does not select an option in advance and does not authorize broader records or continue_running_damaged_asset.
Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for production-safe repair window is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R10 and the CASE-051 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-050.

Required closeout records: post the decided option, date, constraint, alternatives, and Oracle reference in the existing operations thread; and add the resulting Oracle reference, option, date, and constraint as a comment on the existing case file. Verify the persisted record after the Oracle call.
